instruction: The precondition assembly file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the starting assembly shown in the before image. Complete the assembly so it matches the target shape shown in the after image while using the correct physical joint behavior. Toggle Grounded for the yellow part. Apply a Revolute Joint to the blue part, Cylindrical Joints to the pink and blue parts, and a Slider Joint to the bolt and blue ring. Save the completed assembly to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
